svg.text: Hook chain — what runs, what it stops, and what makes it inert
Ten scripts, every one registered in hooks/hooks.json. Every entry is rooted at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and runs with timeout: 10.
GROUPED BY WHAT MAKES A HOOK INERT — NOT BY WHERE IT IS REGISTERED
Every hook but two asks first whether this session has engaged bionic — invoked canonical-sdlc — and exits 0 in silence when it has not; a hook that
finds engagement but no bound run still enforces what needs no run. The two that run before engagement are the one that writes it and the one that
reports at session start. Every registration is in payload/hooks/hooks.json, installed with the plugin; no skill frontmatter carries a hooks: key.
ANY SESSION
two hooks that run before engagement: one writes it, one reports what the last conversation left.
WHAT RUNS
REGISTERED
ARM
WHAT IT DOES
engage.sh
gate: none — any session
plugin PreToolUse · Skill
plugin UserPromptExpansion
RECORD
The one act that puts a session inside bionic: invoking canonical-sdlc, as a Skill call or a typed /bionic:canonical-sdlc,
writes the engagement marker. Every doubt resolves to not engaging, and it never blocks.
session-start.sh
gate: none — any session
plugin SessionStart
· startup|clear|resume|compact
REPORT
What the previous conversation left here, printed at startup, /clear, resume and compact: open rosters, open runs, and the
run this session is bound to. It decides nothing a wall reads.
ENGAGED ONLY
eight scripts that ask first whether this session invoked canonical-sdlc, and exit 0 in silence when it has not.
WHAT RUNS
REGISTERED
ARM
WHAT IT DOES · AND WHAT SILENCES IT
bash-walls.sh
gate: engagement, then the bound plan
plugin PreToolUse · Bash
BLOCK · exit 2
One process for every Bash call: the push-to-main and destructive-database guards, the farm-out wall, the suite budget a
brief declared, and the commit wall, whose ladder is below. Their verdicts fold by one rule: any block is a block, all
reasons print. The commit wall fires only on a real git commit segment (quote-aware).
canonical-sdlc-governing-skill.sh
gate: engagement
plugin PreToolUse · Write|Edit
plugin PostToolUse · Write
BLOCK · exit 2
An artifact under <docs-root>/{specs,plans,adrs,incidents}/ that fails the ladder below — the full frontmatter
contract, plus the three-way design rule on a wave-or-epic spec. It validates Write CONTENT only, so one valid
write covers every later edit of that file: a known hole, listed at the bottom of this page rather than discovered.
dispatch-preflight.sh
gate: engagement, then the bound plan
plugin PreToolUse · Agent
BLOCK · exit 2
A dispatch with no this-session environment attestation or no live Patrol, or whose brief breaks its contract: no single
Expected artifact: path, neither Files: nor Suites:, or a reader whose Questions: is not the set its rigor deals. It also
writes the session roster row a launch is judged by.
execution-recorder.sh
gate: engagement, then the roster
plugin PostToolUse · Bash|Agent
plugin SubagentStart
plugin SubagentStart · arg evidence
plugin SubagentStart · arg adversarial
plugin SubagentStart · arg structure
RECORD
PRESSURE (Bash): the machine is sampled. ROSTER (Agent): a dispatch that actually spawned completes its intended
row, status confirmed, and sets its plan row active. IDENTIFICATION (SubagentStart): the agent's own id joins the
roster BY THAT ID, and the dispatch terms and the checks files for its Questions: are delivered to it at start.
The bare entry pushes the terms; each entry with a question as argument pushes that one checks file, one string each.
stop.sh
gate: engagement
plugin Stop
plugin SubagentStop ↳ via guard
BLOCK · once
One process at turn end: the landing sweep, the Patrol-tick duties, the Patrol revive and the context-spend log, folded
by one rule. A block refuses the turn's end once. On SubagentStop it runs only behind agent-context-guard.sh.
agent-context-guard.sh
gate: agent_id + the session roster
plugin SubagentStop
PASS-THROUGH
Fronts stop.sh on SubagentStop and nothing else: it execs the hook handed to it by argument only when the payload carries
an agent_id AND the session roster exists. Anything else, ambiguity included, exits 0 in silence.
stop-guard.sh
gate: engagement, then the bound plan
plugin PreToolUse · TaskStop
BLOCK · exit 2
A stop of a target this gate can see still working with its contract undelivered: alive inside its declared cadence and
nothing delivered. An idle, delivered or landed target passes, with the look on stderr.
permission-answer.sh
gate: engagement
plugin PermissionRequest
ANSWER · JSON
Answers the platform's permission question for an engaged run, allow or deny with a message, built from the grant over the
facts it collects, so no dialog halts an unattended run. permission-answers: false in .bionic/config.yaml keeps the dialog.
THE TWO SDLC LADDERS — first failure wins, and it names itself
canonical-sdlc-governing-skill.sh
PreToolUse · Write, Edit — the artifact wall
the path is under <docs-root>/{specs,plans,adrs,incidents}/
governing-skill: is present in the frontmatter
canonical_sdlc_version == 14
the triple is present and enum-valid — intent · rigor · scale
no mode: line, and the intent × scale cell is not barred
flags and model_plan present; walk: is required or exempt
## Verification Matrix present once sdlc-step ≥ 3
a wave-or-epic SPEC satisfies one design arm: a flush-left ## Design
in place, a design: pointer that resolves to a file carrying one, or a
design-waived: token
All pass → the Write proceeds. Any failure → exit 2, and the file is never written.
LOG-ONLY: rigor-floor consistency — and it logs user-overridden rather than a
violation when rigor-override: is present. Plans and task-scale artifacts are untouched.
bash-walls.sh
PreToolUse · Bash — the commit wall, on real git commit segments only
the plan this session is bound to → its ## SDLC State, fence-aware
canonical_sdlc_version == 14
current: N — or current: T<n> at scale: task
Step N's evidence keys present, and none of them a placeholder
(todo · pending · in progress · xxx · tbd · placeholder all reject)
at Step 5: cmd / pass / total / output with pass == total, a valid
## Verification Matrix, and a non-empty auditor: once no row is pending
from current: 5 onward — no AC block says provenance: implementation
from current: 5 onward — walk-artifact: resolves to a real file under
<docs-root>/record/ and names the AC (unless walk: exempt)
from current: 6 onward — one fact per owed question at the head, or its waived: line
Valid → the commit proceeds. Otherwise → exit 2, and git never runs.
LOG-ONLY: the epic merge-target check, and the intent-scoped Step-5 keys for
refactor (behavior-preservation · compat-matrix · revert-plan) and tune (baseline · target · re-measure).
ONE SUPPORTED VERSION
canonical_sdlc_version: 14 is the only value either hook accepts.
Anything else — older, empty, malformed — exits 2 naming the value it
found. No grandfathering. This page's three renderings are pinned to it.
THE LOG-ONLY SIDE CHANNEL
$HOME/.claude/logs/<project-slug>/sdlc-audit.md
Deliberately outside every consuming project tree. One line per finding
plus an stderr echo, and it never blocks the wave.
KNOWN HOLES — NOT ENFORCEMENT
The artifact wall validates Write content, not Edit content. Flag VALUES
are never checked, only presence. The evidence gate reads the plan's text,
so an Edit writing evidence for tests never run passes unseen.
